name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler, inside the sequelize.transaction callback, the code explicitly calls Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey: c_custkey } }) before Customer.destroy(...). This matches the explicit application-level child-row delete signal and qualifies because /api/orders/history is documented to return the history of all existed orders, so deleting a customer also removes order rows that another endpoint expects to remain observable.
